decisions.briefing: Markets sold off sharply today with NASDAQ down 2.6% and the S&P 500 down 1.3%, putting conditions firmly in risk-off territory. No new candidates were screened, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash in reserve rather than buying into weakness.

market_education.summary_en: Broad-based selling hit tech-heavy indices harder than the broader market today, with the NASDAQ's 2.6% decline nearly double the S&P 500's 1.3% drop, suggesting growth and momentum names bore the brunt of the pullback. This pattern typically reflects investors rotating out of higher-valuation, higher-beta stocks during periods of risk aversion. Without specific confirmed headlines to cite for today's session, the magnitude and skew of the decline point to a sentiment-driven de-risking move rather than a single company-specific catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股遭遇普遍拋售，科技股為主的納斯達克指數跌幅達2.6%，幾乎是標普500指數1.3%跌幅的兩倍，顯示成長股及高貝塔股承受較大賣壓。此走勢通常反映投資者在風險規避情緒升溫時，從高估值、高波動股票中撤出資金。由於今日並無具體確認的新聞標題可供引用，此次跌幅的幅度與結構差異，較可能是情緒驅動的全面去風險操作，而非單一公司事件所致。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth and tech stocks in favor of safety, often triggering sharp index declines like today's 2.6% NASDAQ drop. The smart move in these conditions is usually to avoid chasing new positions and instead protect capital by holding cash and existing quality holdings.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」(Risk-Off)是指投資者普遍拋售成長股、科技股等較高風險資產，轉向較安全的資產，這往往導致指數大幅下跌，如今日納斯達克指數下跌2.6%。在這種市況下，較穩健的做法通常是避免追高建立新倉位,而是持有現金並保留現有優質持股以保護資本。
